fullContentHtml:
KVS NVS Teaching & Non-Teaching Interview Letter 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) and Navodaya Vidyalaya Sangathan (NVS) has released the Interview Letter for the post of Teaching and Non-Teaching in various subjects and various posts. This recruitment was released for 15,762 posts. Applications for the KVS NVS Teaching & Non-Teaching Recruitment 2025 were accepted from November 14, 2025, to December 11, 2025. The Tier-II examination was conduct on 27-31 March 2026. Candidates who had appeared in Tier-II Examination can download their KVS NVS Teaching & Non-Teaching Interview Letter 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 14 November 2025
  • Application Start Date : 14 November 2025
  • Last Date : 11 December 2025 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 December 2025
  • Correction Date : 13-15 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 10 – 11 January 2026
  • Exam City Details : 26 December 2025
  • Admit Card : 08 January 2026
  • Answer Key : 31 January 2026
  • Tier-I Result : 28 February 2026
  • Tier-II Exam Date : 27-31 March 2026
  • Tier-II Exam City Details : 10 March 2026
  • Tier-II Admit Card : 23 March 2026
  • Tier-II Answer Key : 13 May 2026
  • Tier-II Result : 17 August 2026
  • Interview Letter : 31 August 2026

Application Fee

  • Assistant Commissioner / Principal / Vice Principal :-
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2800/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM : Rs. 500/-
  • PGT/ TGT/ PRT/ AE/ Finance Officer/ AO/ Librarian/ ASO/ Jr Translator :-
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2000/-
  • SSA / Stenographer / JSA / Lab Attendant / Multi-Tasking Staff :-
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1700/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
